connect.foreign: This printer belongs to an earlier BamDude connection. Choose the printer again in the device list.
connect.setup: BamDude has no usable connection. Open the BamDude tab to check its settings.
connect.restart: OrcaSlicer has not allowed this BamDude server yet. The BamDude tab says how to allow it.
connect.refused: The BamDude server refused the connection. Check the API key in the BamDude tab.
